g.title: BT1
g.text: Battery holder, DFRobot FIT0610 (only this one fits the drawer)
3×AA, slide cover, in the pull-out drawer; slide switch bridged (review 2); F1 2 A pico fuse in its + lead at the holder (round 3)
own AA cells: NiMH (recommended) or alkaline, never lithium L91 (over 5 V on VSYS)

g.title: W_BAT
g.text: flat silicone pair (2-wire strip of Adafruit 6181), slack loop

≈ 255 mm assembled from the plug's mating face to splice B (mechanical's model 247 + slack): a 25 mm plug tail (the plug half of the Adafruit 1131), splice A zip-tied on the ledge slots at s 158–161, 240 mm of silicone (only it flexes), splice B behind the holder; + wire marked red; joined to the holder's leads behind the holder, F1 2 A fuse in the + lead at the holder (≥ 40 mm of holder lead, heat-shrink); glued in the drawer tab's groove; a separate cord is the drawer's travel stop (mechanical)

g.title: J_BAT
g.text: JST-PH 2-pin pigtail (the socket half of an Adafruit 1131), wires soldered into BOARD (17,0) + and (19,0) −
polarized and latching (round 3); meter both halves' polarity before the first mating

g.title: D_IR
g.text: 5 mm, 940 nm; R_LS 47 Ω inline at the anode (a wrong plug on J_BZ stays under 100 mA)

g.title: W_LED
g.text: ≈ 80–100 mm EST from J_LED to the emitter well; R_LS 47 Ω heat-shrunk inline at the anode

g.title: Q_PT
g.text: Phototransistor Vishay TEFT4300 (collector = the shorter lead)
3 mm, 940 nm filter; find the collector with the meter before crimping (ASSEMBLY §4)

g.title: W_PT
g.text: TWO whole 30 cm jumpers, plugs in one 3-pin housing (green cavity 1, black 2, cavity 3 plugged; pull tab) onto X_MJ; length measured on R

g.title: X_MJ
g.text: Mouth joint, 3-pin male header, pin 3 pulled (key), in the receiver bay in the dash (7.6 slot)
the sensor's 3-pin housing has cavity 3 plugged, so it fits one way only; unplug here to pull R

g.title: W_PTX
g.text: J_PT extension, ≈ 210 mm EST through the strip duct, away from the XIAO's far end and from W_BZ

g.title: U1
g.text: soldered to BOARD on its headers; the pads are wires from its underside

g.title: W_PWR
g.text: solder to the XIAO BAT pads BEFORE mounting the XIAO

g.title: W_SIG
g.text: XIAO pins to board nets on the underside; MTCK, MTMS, MTDO and MTDI are wires soldered to the back pads BEFORE mounting the XIAO

g.title: BOARD
g.text: VSYS = D1 cathode / C1+ / XIAO BAT pad · RX_D8 / RX_D2 = the 1k from the beam node · VBUS_S = R_VB1 6.8k / R_VB2 10k · SND = R_B 470 · STAT = R_S 100

g.title: SW1
g.text: Undo button, Cherry MX1A-E1NN (MX blue, plate-mount, 2 metal pins), printed 10 × 10 keycap
in the dash; the 1 kΩ sits in the lead at the switch (heat-shrunk)

g.title: W_BTN
g.text: ≈ 220 mm EST through the strip duct to the MX switch; 1 kΩ inline at the switch on the pink wire

g.title: DS1
g.text: 0.91-inch OLED, Waveshare 14657: 128 × 32, white, SSD1306, I²C 0x3C, 36.0 × 12.5 PCB
upright in the dash; panel off except the status view

4 wires soldered into the module's 2.54 holes at its LEFT end (VCC GND SDA SCL), flat on the back; its PH2.0 socket stays unused (no room for the plug in the dash); meter the finished lead before the first plug-in

g.title: W_OLED
g.text: ≈ 200 mm EST: 4 jumpers, cut ends soldered into the module's holes; 5-cavity housing (cavity 5 plugged) at J_OLED in the order SCL G SDA V

g.title: J_OLED
g.text: order SCL G SDA V; 5-cavity housing with cavity 5 plugged; R_SCL / R_SDA 100 Ω on the board

g.title: DS2
g.text: Status LEDs, 2 × 3 mm diffused, side by side under the OLED
Kingbright WP710A10SURDK (red, 630 nm) + WP710A10ZGDK (green InGaN, 525 nm; never a yellow-green); R_G 220 inline at the green cathode, R_R 680 on the board
GPIO5 LOW = red, HIGH = green, Hi-Z = both off; tune R_R / R_G to equal brightness on the bench

g.title: W_STAT
g.text: ≈ 200 mm EST; 3-pin housing on J_STAT; R_G 220 at the green cathode, heat-shrunk (R_R is on the board)

g.title: J_STAT
g.text: R_R 680 Ω (red) and R_S 100 Ω (GPIO5) on the board: the lead carries no raw 3V3

g.title: LS1
g.text: Buzzer, Same Sky CMT-1209-390T (16 Ω magnetic, passive)
standing under the OLED, port up into the open room behind the display (no grille)

g.title: W_BZ
g.text: ≈ 200 mm EST, twisted 1 turn/cm, on the far side of the duct from W_PTX; red on the buzzer's +

g.title: U2
g.text: SparkFun SEN-13963 LIS3DH (first table; clone later)
on headers, SJ1 open; I²C 0x19 or 0x18
